_comment: dsh-personal-hub 共享清单（git 同步，机器无关）：声明个人 DSH 层的组合意图——插件列表、官方基底层、patch 注释。机器特定值一律不放这里：profileDir/pluginsDir 由插件运行时派生（$DSH_HOME 或 ~/.dsh + 本仓 plugins 目录），绝对路径覆盖（pythonPath/pwshPath 等）写进同目录 personal.local.json（gitignore，每台机器自建）。字段：plugins[].name=插件包名（目录名=包名，id=去 dsh- 前缀）；plugins[].patch.config=cordis.patch.yml 覆盖；extraPatches=非插件绑定的部署覆盖。

patch.comment: deepseek-balance: repoDir/opsDir derive from the sibling layout automatically.
plugin-guide: Chinese plugin guide tab in the Plugins settings section.
restart-resume: auto-continue the session after an AI-triggered service restart.
opencode-session-id: inject per-conversation x-opencode-session header into opencode.ai gateway requests (required since 2026-09-05, HTTP 400 MissingSessionID otherwise).
